annotations.title: 株式会社インテルゲート｜intelgate,Inc.

content.text:
**“IntelGate” can refer to a few different things, depending on context:**

1. **A Japanese IT/web company** — **株式会社インテルゲート / intelgate, Inc.**  
   It describes itself as a company that helps businesses use the internet through web content planning, production, advertising, consulting, information services, and local community projects. The name is explained as a coined word combining “Intel” from Italian *internet* and “gate” as an “entrance.” ([intelgate.co.jp](https://intelgate.co.jp/?utm_source=openai))

2. **A term for a U.S. political/intelligence controversy**  
   Some sources use **“Intelgate”** to describe allegations, beginning around 2015, that U.S. CENTCOM intelligence analysis about ISIS/Syria/Iraq was manipulated or distorted. ([military-history.fandom.com](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Intelgate?utm_source=openai))

3. **A software/digital solutions company named INTELGATE**  
   There is also a small company listed on LinkedIn as **INTELGATE**, based in Gazimağusa, described as a software and digital solutions company founded in 2017. ([cy.linkedin.com](https://cy.linkedin.com/company/intelgate?utm_source=openai))

If you saw “IntelGate” in a specific article, app, device, or political discussion, send me the context and I can identify which one it refers to.
